when_to_use.roman_urdu: Dame (asthma) ke attack, seene ki jakdan, aur saans lene mein dushwari ke liye.

side_effects.en: Tremors (shaky hands), fast heartbeat, headaches.
side_effects.roman_urdu: Hath kanpna, dil ki dhadkan tez hona, sar dard.

precautions.en: If you need to use this more than 3 times a week, consult a doctor.
precautions.roman_urdu: Agar iska istemaal zyada karna pade to doctor ko laazmi dikhayein.

dosage_instructions.en: Inhale 1 or 2 puffs as needed for symptom relief.
dosage_instructions.roman_urdu: Saans phoolne par zaroorat ke mutabiq 1 ya 2 puff lein.

food_interactions.roman_urdu: Khane peene ki pabandi nahi.

when_to_use.en: Maintenance treatment for Asthma and COPD.
when_to_use.roman_urdu: Dame (asthma) se musalsal bachao ke liye (Preventer).

side_effects.en: Oral thrush (fungal infection in the mouth), throat irritation, palpitations.
side_effects.roman_urdu: Munh mein infection, galay mein kharash, dhadkan tez hona.

precautions.en: This is a preventer medicine, not for sudden severe asthma attacks.
precautions.roman_urdu: Yeh emergency inhaler nahi hai, iska rozana istemaal zaroori hai.

dosage_instructions.en: Use exactly as prescribed (e.g., 1 or 2 puffs twice daily).
dosage_instructions.roman_urdu: Doctor ke bataye hue tareeqe ke mutabiq din mein 2 baar lein.

food_interactions.en: Rinse mouth with water and spit out after every use to prevent thrush.
food_interactions.roman_urdu: Istemal ke baad munh laazmi dho lein ya kuli karein.

side_effects.roman_urdu: Sar dard, pait dard, aur kabhi kabhar mizaj (mood) mein tabdeeli.

precautions.en: Watch for any unusual mood changes or vivid dreams.
precautions.roman_urdu: Agar mizaj mein gussa ya ajeeb khawab ayein to ehtiyat karein.

precautions.roman_urdu: Achanak saans band hone mein kaam nahi ata. Rozana istemal zaroori hai.
